problem: The final uninstall fence helper ignored Python failure. Its caller uses ||, disabling implicit errexit, so finalization errors could clear the recovery marker and report armed=0/success.
change: Explicitly return failure from the shell helper when Python fails, before marker clearance and armed-state reset. Python finalization bytes and journal protocol are unchanged.
test_scope: Eight new exact-helper/private-filesystem methods plus six unchanged full-uninstaller integration methods with controlled external commands. Normal completion, absence, invalid/missing journal, changed inode, partial restore, injected chmod/fsync/unlink failures and SIGTERM. No installed uninstall.

limits: Partial mode restoration can precede a later failure; this change does not roll it back or prove complete legacy-launch exclusion.
